2608.07118.title: How Much, Then Where: Credit-Conserving Action-to-Token Allocation for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
2608.07118.paper_summary: Credit assignment in multi-turn agent reinforcement learning operates at two levels: assigning trajectory-level credit to actions and distributing each action's credit across its tokens. In this paper, we introduce FACTOR, which separates these decisions. FACTOR uses checkpoint-calibrated TD residuals to assign per-action credits that telescope to the trajectory advantage, and feedback-conditioned teacher-student likelihood gaps to allocate each credit across the realized action tokens. Per-action normalization preserves the action-average coefficient and prevents token-level sign flips. We pair this construction with an action-mean reduction, removing the implicit dependence of an action's scalar surrogate weight on its token length. At the behavior policy and before clipping, each action's inner action-mean surrogate equals its TD credit. FACTOR consistently improves over competitive baselines across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, with every environment-seed comparison favoring FACTOR and the largest gains emerging on the longest-horizon environment. The same hyperparameters transfer without retuning to a larger backbone and to a different model family. Ablations identify TD action credit as the dominant driver of the improvement, with hindsight token allocation contributing complementary gains.
2608.07118.paper_summary_zh: 信用分配在多回合代理強化學習中運作於兩個層次：將軌跡級別的信用分配給行動，並在其標記之間分配每個行動的信用。<lb/>在本文中，我們介紹了FACTOR，它將這些決策分開。<lb/>FACTOR使用檢查點校準的TD殘差來分配每個行動的信用，這些信用會縮減到軌跡優勢，並使用反饋條件的教師-學生似然差距來在實現的行動標記之間分配每個信用。<lb/>每個行動的正規化保留了行動平均係數，並防止了標記級別的符號翻轉。<lb/>我們將這一構造與行動均值減少配對，消除了行動的標量替代權重對其標記長度的隱性依賴。<lb/>在行為策略下且在裁剪之前，每個行動的內部行動均值替代等於其TD信用。<lb/>FACTOR在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld等競爭基準上持續改進，所有環境-隨機種子比較均有利於FACTOR，並且在最長時間範圍的環境中出現了最大的增益。<lb/>相同的超參數在不重新調整的情況下轉移到更大的骨幹和不同的模型系列。<lb/>消融實驗確定TD行動信用是改進的主要驅動因素，而事後標記分配則貢獻了補充增益。
